Excellent Dinner Experience
Sep 2026 • Couples
If I’m being completely honest, this was overall a really good experience. The food was good, and the price-to-quality ratio is excellent. My only disappointment was that the restaurant seemed unable to do much about inconsiderate customers.
For the location, I definitely recommend getting a table on the balcony with the city view, especially on the 2nd or 3rd floor. Sapa is really lively at night, and it’s a great atmosphere to just sit back and enjoy the view.

Unfortunately, while we were initially seated on the balcony, someone at the table behind us started smoking a cigarette. Even though it’s an outdoor area, the smoke was blowing directly toward us, and we were inhaling quite a lot of it. We eventually had to move inside, which was a bit disappointing because we were really enjoying the balcony and the city view. I just wish the restaurant could do something about situations like this, especially when other guests are clearly being affected.

On the positive side, the staff were really friendly and clearly making an effort despite the language barrier. Nhung and the other gentleman who assisted us were both so helpful and welcoming. I really appreciated their effort to make us feel comfortable.

Overall, a 9.5/10 experience. Great food, great value, a really nice view, and friendly staff. The smoking situation was just the one thing that took away from an otherwise really enjoyable evening.

A memorable experience at Le Petit Gecko
Aug 2026 • Friends
From the moment I walked in, I was genuinely impressed by the whole experience. The restaurant has a charming and inviting atmosphere, with a beautiful setting that makes you feel comfortable and relaxed. Every dish was thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and full of flavor, with fresh ingredients that really stood out.

The service was equally outstanding. The staff were polite, attentive, and incredibly welcoming without ever being intrusive. You can truly feel the effort and passion that goes into creating a memorable experience for every guest.

Overall, it was much more than just a great meal—it was an experience I genuinely enjoyed from beginning to end. I would happily return and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for delicious food, wonderful service, and a lovely atmosphere.
